name: United International Transportation Company
summary: United International Transportation Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the leasing and rental of vehicles, and used car sales in Saudi Arabia. It operates through five segments: Leasing, Rental, Used Car, and Other. The company provides services, such as short term local and international rental, long term rental, car rental, chauffeur, limousine and cross border rental, corporate leasing, and frequent travelers loyalty programs. It also rents and leases heavy vehicles and equipment, as well as trades in heavy vehicles, equipment, and spare parts.
